lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns; the first column posterior to the gills contains approximately four distinct spots, with subsequent columns showing larger, more widely spaced spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, forming a clear geometric grid where blobs act as nodes, particularly visible in the posterior half of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature along the upper lateral flank, defined by a high-contrast transition between a light-reflective upper margin and a shadowed lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Multiple high-luminance circular blobs are distributed across the visible lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
